protocol.objective: 100% measured feasibility first; then median24D, P25, P10, lower MDD, mean, lower turnover
protocol.question: Can joint entry availability and allocation/signal parameters cross the known development feasibility bottleneck without weakening any rule?
protocol.hypothesis: Joint looser entry gates and score/allocation choices may improve portfolio availability and avoid residual holdings on the development hard episode.
protocol.alternative: Frozen corporate-action uncertainty and portfolio constraints dominate all permitted parameter changes.
protocol.selection: 100% measured pass and completeness on ALL development and validation; validation median/P25 not worse than baseline; momentum +/-0.05 stability; official unknowns remain blocked
protocol.diagnostic_policy: Failed bottleneck candidates may fill diagnostic shortlist, never adopted. One known development failure proves inadmissibility, not an aggregate return estimate.
protocol.stop_condition: One predeclared bounded expansion; stop on engineering/audit error; freeze after validation; no holdout or recent tuning.
protocol.prior_exposure: Validation reused for model selection; historical holdout and recent already exposed in earlier rounds, isolated from this search but not pristine.
protocol.post_freeze: 23 holdout monthly,20 recent monthly,16 seasonal analogues; last126 complete rolling starts for baseline and new diagnostic leader. Overlap is not independent.
